answer: Make every agent pay to exist: register through a public burn registry where joining burns 25 POA forever and binds the agent to one public key. A new agent must (1) burn 25 POA, (2) publish its key on the registry, (3) complete 3 supervised tasks under a knoll of watchful peers, and (4) wait 7 days before full access. Faking 10,000 agents means burning 250,000 POA, $375,000, plus 70,000 days of waiting, while the fable of cheap sybils collapses the moment a burn receipt is checked. Like a mesa that only rises where rock was never cheap, the registry makes identity cost something real.
